experiments.name: Concierge MVP
experiments.success_metric: Deliver value manually to ≥3 users; ≥2 would pay again
experiments.hypothesis: validation report creates enough value that indie founders retain after a manual run
experiments.method: Manually run the workflow for 3 indie founders; log time-to-value and objections

experiments.name: Fake-door / smoke landing
experiments.success_metric: ≥5% CTR to waitlist or ≥10 qualified signups
experiments.hypothesis: indie founders will click/sign up for a solution to uncertain idea demand
experiments.method: One landing page + CTA; drive a small paid or community traffic burst; no full product

experiments.name: Riskiest Assumption Test
experiments.success_metric: Riskiest assumption falsified or supported with ≥1 concrete evidence artifact
experiments.hypothesis: Users will pay for validation report within 14 days of a credible promise
experiments.method: Write the single riskiest assumption, design the cheapest test ≤$100 / ≤2 weeks, run it, record evidence grade

pestle.political: Export controls and AI policy can change model access/cost; keep vendor flexibility.

pestle.social: indie founders adopt tools via communities and peer proof; trust > hype for uncertain idea demand.
pestle.legal: Respect user data, scraped evidence licenses, and marketplace ToS if integrating third-party APIs.
pestle.environmental: Model inference has energy cost — prefer smaller models / caching for validation loops.
